_note: One fixed profile per speaker ID so every line of a character sounds the same. Character voices are Kokoro's stock synthetic voices; the narrator is the owner-approved Piper LJ Speech voice (public-domain dataset). None is cloned from a real person. 'fx' names a post-processing chain in tools/audio/generate_voice.py.

staff_voss.name: Dr Evelyn Voss
staff_voss.direction: Composed, measured, faintly formal medical director.

intercom.name: Hospital intercom
intercom.direction: Neutral PA announcer through an old ceiling speaker system.

walla_staff_a.name: Background staff A
walla_staff_a.direction: Walla only; mixed distant and unintelligible.

walla_staff_b.name: Background staff B
walla_staff_b.direction: Walla only; mixed distant and unintelligible.

walla_staff_c.name: Background staff C
walla_staff_c.direction: Walla only; mixed distant and unintelligible.

pt_mara_ellis.name: Mara Ellis
pt_mara_ellis.direction: Former records worker; tired, careful, wants to be heard.

narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.direction: The owner-approved recap narrator voice (Piper LJ Speech via Sherpa-ONNX), used for descriptive text, observed behaviour and silence. Same settings as audio/narration/provenance.json.

player.name: Protagonist (default)
player.direction: Newly graduated attending. Default voice only; the protagonist is customizable, so a second profile is a planned addition.

player_female.name: Protagonist (female)
player_female.direction: Female variant of every player line, used when the protagonist profile chooses the female voice (generate_voice.py VOICE_VARIANTS). Same delivery and settings as the default player profile.
